states.web: The submit button shows the chat status as an icon: corner-down-left at ready, a Spinner at submitted, a stop square at streaming and an X at error; the textarea shows its placeholder when empty, and the Input Group carries the focus ring. Success is the draft clearing after onSubmit resolves; a rejected onSubmit keeps the draft; hover and pressed come from the Input Group buttons.

interaction.web: Enter submits unless an IME composition is running or the submit button is disabled, Shift+Enter inserts a newline, Backspace on an empty textarea removes the last staged file, pasting files stages them, and dropping files stages them (anywhere on the document with globalDrop). While submitted or streaming with onStop set, the submit button calls onStop instead of submitting. Blob URLs are converted to data URLs before onSubmit.
